svg.title: Abid Azamy, security operations
svg.desc: Abid Azamy, security operations. A cipher wheel of rotating rings carries the skills SIEM and threat detection, incident investigation, SOAR, EDR/XDR, MDR, ITSM and ticket engines, the certifications Security+, CySA+ and CASP+, and a stream of simulated log lines. A fixed reading window at the top lights up whatever passes beneath it. Simulation, not live monitoring.
